profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
Experiences in:
hardware-software codesign
compiler support for parallel architectures and accelerators
managed runtime
software performance tuning

Skills: C/C++, gdb, LLVM, simulators, bash/python scripts

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
End-to-end deep learning software performance optimization in large scale GPU systems.
MLIR based compiler optimizations in ML framework for the next generation GPUs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented various speculative compiler optimizations on hardware-software co-designed processors.
Performed performance analysis and optimization of ML framework for Intel GPUs.

positions.title: Graduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Static/Dynamic optimizations for CPU/GPU heterogeneous systems
- Managed Runtime for CPU/GPU heterogeneous systems
- Custom OpenCL library implementations
- Approximate Computing on GPUs

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: - Performed analysis/study on the impact of multi-core binary translation.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: - Language design & implementation for customized ISAs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed a dynamic instrumentation infrastructures for ARM ISA
- Code optimization for multi-threaded applications
- Developed a profiling tool for multi-threaded applications

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked on re-targeting part of legacy binaries to FPGA exploiting ILP
- Researched on the runtime thread management for SMP architectures.
